screened_threats.name: Erosion / Erosion-Corrosion
screened_threats.key_driver: Dynamic fluid flow in Crude Oil / Hydrocarbon Process service; turbulence and impingement velocity at directional turns.
screened_threats.failure_mode: Localized wall thinning, scallop marks, horseshoe depressions, sudden rupture.
screened_threats.recommended_ndt: Grid UT (Ultrasonic Thickness), Automated PAUT, Profile Radiography (RT).
screened_threats.where_to_inspect: Fitting Extrados (Outer Curvature of Elbows), Branch Connection Crotches, and Reducer Necks.

screened_threats.name: Deadleg & Stagnant Invert Corrosion
screened_threats.key_driver: Stagnant aqueous fluid / water dropout in dead ends, bleeders, and low points.
screened_threats.failure_mode: Under-deposit pitting, bottom-of-line groove thinning, pinhole perforation.
screened_threats.recommended_ndt: 6 o'clock Spot UT, High-Density Scanning UT, Profile RT, Video Borescope.
screened_threats.where_to_inspect: 6 o'clock bottom invert of horizontal runs, drain pots, and bleeder deadleg sumps.

screened_threats.name: Mechanical Vibration Fatigue Cracking
screened_threats.key_driver: Piping system pulsations and cyclic flow fluctuations acting on cantilever small-bore branches.
screened_threats.failure_mode: Transgranular fatigue cleavage cracks at stress concentrations, high-energy snap rupture.
screened_threats.recommended_ndt: Dye Penetrant (PT), Magnetic Particle (MT), Small-bore vibration monitoring and bracing inspection.
screened_threats.where_to_inspect: Small Bore Piping connections (NPS <= 2 in), bleeder valve socket welds, and drain nipple attachments.
